raw_segments.text: Then Juno told her a lying tale and said, I want you to endow me with some of those
fascinating charms, the spells of which bring all things mortal and immortal to your feet.
I am going to the world's end to visit Oceanus, from whom all we gods proceed, and Mother
They received me in their house, took care of me, and brought me up, having taken me
over from Rhea when Jove imprisoned Great Saturn in the depths that are under earth
I must go and see them that I may make peace between them.
They have been quarreling, and are so angry that they have not slept with one another
If I can bring them round and restore them to one another's embraces, they will be grateful
to me and love me forever afterwards.
